title: NAMEOF of a column is 'Table'[Column], spelled as the model spells them

source.supports: the default result is the fully qualified, escaped name; the page's example 1 turns 'Sales'[ORDER QUANTITY] into 'Sales'[Order Quantity]

derivation: The column is Sales[Quantity] in the model; written 'sales'[QUANTITY] here. Example 1 of the page shows the model's spelling coming back: 'Sales'[Quantity].
